articles.title: Lost 'mega-escarpment' across ancient USA may explain Grand Canyon's missing billion years - Phys.org
articles.description: Scientists have found evidence that a colossal cliff stretching thousands of kilometers across ancient North America may have exposed the heart of the Grand Canyon nearly a billion years before it was carved by the Colorado River.
